name: DialogContent
description: Centered modal surface for a `<Dialog>` — renders above the overlay with focus trap and Escape-to-close

props.name: closeOnClickOutside
props.description: Whether clicking the overlay closes the dialog

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether pressing Escape closes the dialog

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Additional class for the overlay behind the dialog

props.name: closable
props.description: Shows an ✕ close button in the header

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when the ✕ button is clicked
